root_cause.message: ReadTimedOut while reading redis big key blocking media session payload

expected.business_impact: /media/session/load production business path is affected by redis_bigkey_blocking

primary_evidence.trace: Runtime trace follows media-gateway -> media-bff -> media-service -> redis-media and localizes the main fault at media-service.
primary_evidence.log: Root service logs contain ReadTimedOut and redis_bigkey_blocking keywords.
primary_evidence.metric: Metric redis.network.egress.bytes_per_second breaches threshold on media-service.

non_root_noise: cdn-service latency is normal and outside redis bigkey path
background audit-service warning is outside the affected call path
noise-service metric is normal and outside the affected call path
